searchText: okay so I was looking more into it and it turns out that we don't need the `automerge` label for kodiak to auto merge. Looks like kodiak alone is the perfect solution. in reponse to this I removed `automerge` from all PRs <@!104006934562107392> I'm not sure what's happening, but this PR seems not to have automatically merged, despite everything passing. And I notice you made asked an enigmatic question there a few minutes ago. I'll refrain from trying to commit more work tonight until things are OK. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4700 yeah sorry about this <@!683653554631868440> the failure to merge is due to a tool not working as expected. The enigmatic question you're referencing (I think) is a request to the maintainers of that tool to see why it is not working. Yeah, I just noticed your conversation with them. A good excuse for me to log off and go play my guitar 😉 have fun 😃 if this happens again then you'll need to edit the body, title, add a label etc. anything to "refresh" the PR I'm in the process of discussing a feature to prevent the freezing with the team of kodiak, but that wont' be ready immediately.
